question: By availing two successive discounts of 20% and 10%, a customer got a discount of ₹23,800. Determine the marked price of the item.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Equivalent discount % for successive discounts of 20% and 10% = 20 + 10 − (20 × 10) ÷ 100 = 28%.

Given that 28% of the Marked Price = ₹23,800.

⇒ MP = (23,800 ÷ 28) × 100 = 850 × 100 = ₹85,000.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹85,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Successive discounts = 20% and 10%

Total discount obtained = ₹23,800

**Formula Used:**

Effective Discount % = d₁ + d₂ − (d₁ × d₂) ÷ 100

Discount = Marked Price (MP) − Selling Price (SP)

 
 MP (100%)
 
 
• 
 

 −20%

 
 80%

 
• 
 

 −10%

 
 SP (72%)

 

 Total Discount = 100% − 72% = 28%
 28% = ₹23,800

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let Marked Price (MP) = 100x

⇒ SP after 20% discount = 100x − 20% of 100x = 80x

⇒ SP after further 10% discount = 80x − 10% of 80x = 72x

⇒ Total Discount = MP − Final SP = 100x − 72x = 28x

⇒ We are given that the discount is ₹23,800.

⇒ 28x = 23,800

⇒ x = 23,800 ÷ 28 = 850

⇒ Marked Price (100x) = 850 × 100 = 85,000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹85,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Discount Formula

When two discounts d₁% and d₂% are given successively, the equivalent single discount is [d₁ + d₂ − (d₁ × d₂) ÷ 100]%.

Marked Price & Selling Price Relation

Selling Price (SP) = Marked Price (MP) × (1 − Discount% ÷ 100).

Buy X Get Y Free

Discount % = [Free Items ÷ Total Items] × 100. This is another popular discount scheme in exams.
